messages:
jamal: hey all, accepted the org invite but github says "You need to be invited to access this organization" when I try to open a private repo. clone via SSH shows Permission denied. any tips?

rachel: welcome jamal! quick question: did you accept with the account that has your work email? sometimes invites land on a different GH account.

jamal: i accepted the email sent to jamal.personal@gmail.com because that's what popped up. i do have jamal@redwood.ai as a separate GH account but i forgot.

ivan (it): that explains it. org seats are tied to the account that accepted. easiest path: 1) tell me which account you want to use (personal or work) 2) if you want to use work (recommended), i'll revoke the current accept and re-invite your work email. note you'll need 2FA + SSO auth after accepting.

jamal: let's use the work account (jamal@redwood.ai). please re-invite there.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Redwood enforces SSO and 2FA for org access. See: https://redwood.dev/onboarding/gh-access

ivan (it): done. removed the old accept and sent a fresh invite to jamal@redwood.ai. when you accept, make sure to: add/verify that email on your GH account, enable 2FA, then authorize SSO from the organization page. ping me if the authorize button errors.

jamal: accepted, enabled TOTP 2FA, clicked authorize. SSH test now: ```$ ssh -T git@github.com
Hi jamal! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.```

rachel: nice. @ivan (it) can you add jamal to eng-platform and grant write on redwood/infra-templates?

ivan (it): added jamal -> eng-platform and granted repo access. you should get an email confirmation.

jamal: cloned and pushed a tiny doc change, everything works. thanks! :tada:

onboarding-bot: If resolved, reply with "resolved" to close this thread.
